description: Validate a .toc manifest: interface version against the target client, flavor suffix consistency, unrecognised directives the client silently drops, SavedVariables names, and files listed but missing (or present but unlisted). Run this whenever an addon fails to load or shows as out of date.

fileName.description: Filename to assume when validating inline contents, e.g. MyAddon_Vanilla.toc.

path.description: Path to a .toc file, or to an addon folder.

name: wow_toc_validate
title: Validate an addon .toc manifest
